reproduction_target: Multi-omics analysis of black raspberry (Rubus occidentalis) fruit ripening: whole-genome bisulfite (BS-Seq) methylome processing and per-cytosine methylation calling with custom scripts, DMR identification with CGmapTools, RNA-Seq expression processing, DESeq2 differential expression, WGCNA co-expression module inference, module-trait correlation with anthocyanin metabolite data, homology-based chromatin-remodeler gene search, and the replicate-reproducibility statistics (500-kb window correlation, PCA). Wet-lab work (plant material collection, bisulfite treatment and BS-Seq library construction, RNA extraction and RNA-Seq library construction, Illumina sequencing, metabolite extraction and HPLC-DAD anthocyanin quantification) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis list built from the Methods sections ('Reference genome used in this study', 'BS-Seq Library Construction... Data Processing and Sequence Analysis', 'DMR analysis by CGmapTools', 'RNA-Seq Library Construction... Data Processing and Analysis', 'Statistics and reproducibility') plus the tool invocations named in Results (DESeq2, WGCNA, homology-based gene search). The Methods are unusually thin: the BS-Seq and RNA-Seq processing paragraphs delegate entirely to previously published methods (refs 44, 45) and to 'Supplementary Information', which is not part of the main text and was not available at this stage. No aligner, trimmer, quantifier, or version is named anywhere in the main text. Methylation calling is attributed to unnamed, undeposited 'custom scripts'. Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Reference genome retrieval: Rubus occidentalis v3.0 downloaded from Genome Database for Rosaceae (https://www.rosaceae.org/analysis/268), used for all data processing and analysis

BS-Seq read processing and alignment to the R. occidentalis v3.0 reference (incl. lambda spike-in conversion-efficiency check); method delegated verbatim to 'previously published methods' (ref 44) and 'Supplementary Information' — no aligner, trimmer, or parameters named in the main text
Per-cytosine methylation calling with 'custom scripts': C/T read counting, exclusion of sites with a single mapped read, binomial test (p < 0.05) to call methylated cytosines
Average methylation level computation per CG/CHG/CHH context, [C/(C+T)] x 100 over filtered sites, and feature-level means over specific genomic features
DMR identification with CGmapTools (ref 16) at cutoffs p < 0.05, CG > 20%, CHG > 10%, CHH > 8%; leaf methylation used as baseline reference for each fruit ripening stage
DMR merging: two or more DMRs separated by less than 300 bp merged into one merged-DMR
RNA-Seq read processing and expression quantification; method delegated to 'previously published methods' (ref 45) and 'Supplementary Information' — no aligner or quantifier named in the main text
Differential expression with DESeq2 (FDR < 0.05, more than two-fold change) across the five ripening stages

Gene regulatory network inference by weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) on 14,457 highly regulated genes (DESeq2 FDR < 0.05, >2-fold), yielding 14 modules; parameters deferred to Supplementary Information

Module-trait association: Pearson correlation between module eigengenes and sample traits (metabolite/anthocyanin data), significance by Student's t-test; hierarchical clustering on the resulting r values
Global DNA methylation comparison between leaf and the five fruit ripening stages by Student's t-test
BS-Seq replicate reproducibility: correlation coefficient of average methylation levels in 500-kb genomic windows across 12 biological replicates (leaf + five stages)
RNA-Seq replicate reproducibility: principal component analysis on transcript data from 14 biological replicates across five fruit ripening stages
Homology-based gene search for chromatin remodelers and DNA methylation machinery (44 remodelers identified, clustered into two expression groups); method deferred to Supplementary Information

headline.static_readiness: 0/14 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 14 computational steps cap at NI even under the most generous inference-inclusive reading. There is no code-availability statement and no repository of any kind (no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/figshare/OSF link appears anywhere in the full text). No software version is pinned for any tool in the main text (CGmapTools, DESeq2 and WGCNA are named but unversioned; the BS-Seq and RNA-Seq processing pipelines name no tool at all and delegate to refs 44/45 plus Supplementary Information). The data availability statement is a placeholder - 'uploaded to NCBI (accession number: GSE)' with no accession digits - so no input dataset is resolvable, and BS-Seq data are not covered by any availability statement at all. This paper does not become R-star-eligible via stage 2: there is no code artifact to read.
headline.coverage: 14 computational steps assessed from Methods prose plus tool invocations named in Results; 6 wet-lab steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope. Data availability statement present but non-functional (placeholder accession). No code availability statement present. Supplementary Information, to which several Methods paragraphs delegate, was not retrievable at this stage and could not raise any axis.

gaps.missing: No code repository, scripts, notebooks, commands, or configuration files are provided anywhere in the paper, and there is no code availability statement. Methylation calling is explicitly attributed to unnamed 'custom scripts' that are not deposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit an analysis repository (GitHub + Zenodo DOI) containing the BS-Seq alignment/calling scripts, the CGmapTools DMR commands and cutoffs, the RNA-Seq quantification pipeline, and the DESeq2/WGCNA/PCA R scripts.

gaps.missing: The statement reads 'The raw and processed RNA-seq data reported in this paper has been uploaded to NCBI (accession number: GSE)' - a literal placeholder with no accession number, so the RNA-Seq data cannot be retrieved. The BS-Seq/methylome data (approximately 1.06 billion reads, 12 libraries) are not mentioned in the availability statement at all. The metabolome (HPLC-DAD anthocyanin) table used as the WGCNA trait matrix is also not deposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Replace the placeholder with the real GEO/SRA accessions, add a separate accession (GEO/SRA/ENA) for the BS-Seq libraries, and deposit the anthocyanin quantification table as a machine-readable supplementary data file.

gaps.where: Software environment for every named and unnamed tool
gaps.missing: No conda environment, lockfile, container, requirements file, or session info. Zero software version pins in the main text: CGmapTools, DESeq2 and WGCNA are named without versions; no R version is given; the BS-Seq and RNA-Seq processing tools are not named at all.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a pinned environment (conda-lock/pixi.lock or a container digest) and record exact versions of R, Bioconductor, DESeq2, WGCNA and CGmapTools, plus the alignment/quantification tools used.

gaps.where: C2, C7 (read processing), C9 (WGCNA), C10 (clustering), C12 (correlation), C13 (PCA), C14 (homology search)
gaps.missing: Read trimming/QC/alignment parameters are absent (delegated to refs 44/45 and Supplementary Information). WGCNA soft-threshold power, minimum module size, merge cut height and network type are not stated. The hierarchical clustering linkage/distance, the correlation type used for the 500-kb replicate reproducibility, and the PCA input transform and gene filter are unstated. The homology-based chromatin-remodeler search gives no query set, search tool, or e-value/identity thresholds.
gaps.how_to_close: State the full parameter set inline (or in the deposited scripts) rather than deferring to prior publications and Supplementary Information.

gaps.where: C2, C7, C14 - Methods paragraphs 'BS-Seq ... Data Processing and Sequence Analysis', 'RNA-Seq ... Data Processing and Analysis', and the homology search
gaps.missing: Method-by-reference: the processing pipelines are described only as 'following the methods of previous published methods (44)' and 'Previously published methods were applied for data processing and downstream analysis, including WGCNA analysis (45)', with the remaining detail delegated to Supplementary Information that is not part of the assessed full text. No tool is named in the main-text prose for these steps.
gaps.how_to_close: Restate the pipeline in the Methods (tool names, versions, commands) instead of a bare citation, or point to the deposited repository.

gaps.missing: The genome build is pinned (R. occidentalis v3.0, GDR analysis 268), which is good, but the annotation release/GFF version used for gene-level assignment, the DMR-to-feature mapping and the transposon annotation is not specified, and no file checksums are given.
gaps.how_to_close: Cite the exact GDR file names/dates (or a Zenodo mirror) with checksums for both the FASTA and the annotation GFF used.
